name: bun (JavaScript/TypeScript runtime)
purpose: PowOS's JavaScript/TypeScript runtime at /usr/bin/bun, the aarch64 build of the release the PC image curls in (no Arch package carries it): it runs the manager's TypeScript sandbox (unit ai-sandbox) and PowOS apps' builds
installedBy: targets/android/install-powos-android.sh (the rootfs build: bun-linux-aarch64.zip from oven-sh/bun's latest release; HACK marker there - the manifest can't carry binaries outside packages)
